text:
lina: starting change window for routing-service v6.1.0 -> prod-na. plan: canary 7% for 7m then ramp 30% for 13m. gating on regional p95, global 5xx, and error budget. kicking off canary now.

deploy-bot: rollout started by lina. env=prod-na, version=v6.1.0. steps=[7%:7m,30%:13m]. auto-rollback thresholds: regional p95>700ms OR global 5xx>0.6% sustained 2m. annotating change window.

slo-bot: baseline snapshot: prod-na p95=120ms, global 5xx=0.07%. current p95(3m)=125ms, 5xx=0.08%. No hard alarms; watch for tail.

devon: quick note: /route/resolve has a small cluster of p95 spikes (~480ms) starting ~3m after canary. digging traces.

ops-bot: K8s event: pod routing-cc3 on node-n4 restarted (OOMKill) at 2026-03-21T19:02:11Z.

harpreet: logs show `Mar 21 19:02:10 ERROR runtime: allocation failed` on node-n4. seems correlated with a larger batch of concurrent lookups after canary.

lina: hold progression. keep at 7%. slo-bot, run a diff (10m pre vs 5m post) and list top endpoints and nodes by delta. also can we mark this change window as "investigating OOMs" in the release notes?

slo-bot: delta report: /route/resolve p95 +240ms in prod-na, /route/batch p95 +90ms. Node-level: node-n4 shows highest delta; node-n1 small delta. Suggest mitigations: divert canary to low-latency pool, or enable route-fallback-quantized for /route/resolve.

devon: i can try diverting the 7% to a warmed pool (2 nodes) with increased heap and preloaded caches. infra, can we carve the warmed-pool out quickly?

ops-bot: provisioning warmed-pool(2nodes, heap=3.2G) now; ETA ~70s.

harpreet: small workaround: enable route-level backpressure to limit concurrent batch size on /route/resolve to 8 for canary traffic; reduces mem spikes but increases latency slightly.

lina: decision: divert the 7% canary to warmed-pool AND enable backpressure (concurrency cap) on canary routes. annotate change window: "diverted to warmed-pool + concurrency cap; hold ramp". we will NOT advance until stable for 12m.

deploy-bot: actioned: traffic diverted; routing policy updated; change window note appended. auto-rollback remains armed.

slo-bot: 5m post-diversion: prod-na p95 improving from 360ms -> 150ms; global 5xx back to 0.08%. one remaining OOM observed on node-n4 but unrelated (old pod). continuing 12m watch.

devon: tracing confirms reduced model cache churn on warmed nodes. I still want to reproduce in perf lab; filing INFRA-2124.

ops-bot: ticket created: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INFRA-2124 (routing-service memory pressure repro and warmup plan).

harpreet: note for release notes: "paused ramp due to memory allocation failures on subset of nodes during canary; diverted to warmed pool and applied concurrency cap; investigating warmup + heap tuning."

lina: good work. follow-up sync in 20m. tagging @oncall. :white_check_mark:
